verdict.rationale: Tilled shows glancing support for money legibility. Closing batches via API is pitched as enabling "easier reconciliation", the Dashboard exposes per-merchant payout settings, and pricing templates imply platform fee structures. None of the evidence shows a ledger view of balances or end-to-end movement tracing. Missing for 10: per-seller balance reporting, visibility into the platform's own fee/revenue accounts, traceability from charge through split to payout, penny-level reconciliation reports or exports, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
